overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies Crushed Red Chilli Flakes for wholesale, private label, and export orders. The flakes are made from selected red chillies using a controlled process of cleaning, drying, crushing, and sieving. Buyers can request standard grades or custom mesh, seed ratio, color profile, and heat level according to their specification.

This product offers visible chilli texture, natural red color, and easy handling for food manufacturing and foodservice use. TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter from India. We support bulk supply, OEM and private label projects, samples on request, and export documentation support. Packaging can be arranged in 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5-10 kg bags, and small private-label pouches and jars.
highlights: No added color, salt, or preservatives unless requested
